question: Two washing machines are brought for a total of ₹10,750. One of them is sold at 25% profit and the other at 10% loss. If the selling price of both the washing machines is the same, then what is the difference (in ₹ ) between their cost prices?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Let the cost price of one machine machine be "a".

⇒ cost price of other washing machine = (₹ 10,750 - a)

Difference in the cost of two washing machines = a - (₹ 10,750 - a) = 2a - ₹ 10,750 

According to the question-

⇒ 1.25 × a = 0.9 × (₹ 10,750 - a)

⇒ 1.25a = 9,675 - 0.9a 

⇒ 1.25a + 0.9a = 9,675

⇒ 2.15a = 9,675

∴ a = 9675over2.15 = ₹ 4500

Substituting the value of "a" in the different of the cost, we get-

⇒ Difference of the cost = 2 × ₹ 4500 - ₹ 10,750 = ₹ 9,000 - ₹ 10,750 = -₹ 1,750 

**∴ The difference of the cost of the washing machines is ₹ 1,750.**
